Claude Cage

**把 Claude 大小姐关起来，为了更好地保护我们的相遇** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/releases) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) **[项目主页](https://claude-cage.com/) · [下载应用](https://claude-cage.com/#download) · [插件市场](https://claude-cage.com/plugins/) · [使用文档](https://claude-cage.com/docs/) · [常见问题](https://claude-cage.com/docs/troubleshooting/)** [简体中文](README.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md) · [العربية](README.ar.md) · [فارسی](README.fa.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [မြန်မာဘာသာ](README.my.md) · [Беларуская](README.be.md) · [پښتو](README.ps.md) · [دری](README.prs.md) · [አማርኛ](README.am.md) · [Soomaali](README.so.md) · [ትግርኛ](README.ti.md) · [Français](README.fr.md)
## 设计理念 1. **Claude 本身是安全的，但它的运行外壳（harness）及相关程序不是**——包括 Claude Code、Claude Desktop，以及浏览器里接触到的邮件、网页与环境信号。 2. **想要在保证安全的前提下使用 Claude 的能力，通常有两条路线：反向代理，或者远程控制**——要么把 Claude 从远端服务器拉出来直接运行在主机上，要么把 Claude 部署在受控环境里，由它远程操作主机。我们认为后者更安全，也更合规。 3. **因此，Cage 的核心思想是：为 Claude 及相关程序打造一个轻量化的本地隔离环境，再通过标准 MCP 插件，让 Claude 安全、受控地使用本机能力**——每一次越出环境的调用都有明确的权限边界与用户确认，比直接暴露 SSH 更安全。 这样一来，Cage 同时实现了三个目标： - **把危险的部分关起来，把有用的能力放出来。** Claude 大小姐安心待在 Cage 里，坐在她的小螃蟹上，只需把手伸出来处理外面的工作——不必在 Cage 里重新搭一整间办公室。 - **通过插件市场，与开源社区解耦协作。** 我们开放了[插件市场（cage-plugins）](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/cage-plugins)：**插件 = MCP + 扩展**，分别对应「给 Claude 的能力」与「Cage 工作台的定制化」。开源社区可以在插件市场持续贡献工具、桌面控制与工作流扩展，而不必挤进 Cage 主仓库的 Issue 列表；Cage 核心维护团队也能更聚焦于隔离环境、网络与工作台本身的打磨。 - **合规、安全、轻量化、本地、低成本，一键安装、一键配置、开箱即用。** 我们不再需要维护复杂臃肿的多系统客机，不再担心 Claude 的能力被困在孤岛里，也无需承担高昂的云端成本或数据安全隐患——在自己电脑上就能优雅地实现这一切。 ## 受够了 Anthropic 作为一个只是想和 Claude 对话与合作的正常用户，受够了折腾各种 VPS，指纹浏览器，环境检测，面对封号的担惊受怕和财产损失。我们提出 **Claude Cage** 项目：**一个开箱即用的桌面程序，配置好自己的网络代理，集中管理轻量化隔离环境、时区语言、环境检查与插件能力。** Claude Cage 在一个小型的 Debian 13 环境里运行官方 Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop，macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上都是同一个环境。终端、浏览器、编辑器、官方 Claude Desktop 与插件市场汇集在同一个工作台，项目按需共享，网络独立管理；既可以通过插件安全调用本机能力，也可以连接自己的服务器，或用手机接续电脑上的任务。支持以下几个重点功能： - 和主机隔离的网络设置，Cage 自己接管和代理内部的所有网络流量 - 和主机隔离的指纹设置，包括时区、语言等，支持自动与代理 IP 同步 - 针对 Claude 使用过程中的全链路适配（浏览器登录，授权，claude code 进程） - 内置网络与隔离检查，关键检查失败或证据不完整时暂停外网；社区和第三方检测提供补充参考 **使用 Cage 的环境检测结果：** | 网络与隔离检查 | 浏览器环境检测（社区参考） | | :---: | :---: | | | | [FuckClaude](https://fuck-claude.vercel.app/) · [LinXiaoTao / GitHub](https://github.com/LinXiaoTao/FuckClaude) **Cage 运行主界面：** ![Cage](www/public/workbench-2026-11.jpg) ## 你可以用它做什么 - **在一个窗口里完成工作。** 用终端运行 Claude Code，用编辑器查看改动，用 Cage 浏览器预览服务和完成登录。 - **通过插件市场解锁全部能力。** 内置开放的[插件市场（cage-plugins）](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/cage-plugins)，插件 = MCP + 扩展：既能让环境里的 Claude 通过标准 MCP 安全、受控地使用本机能力（如桌面键鼠控制、Office 文档、Blender、命令行工具等），也能通过沙箱页面定制 Cage 工作台。主机插件默认受权限声明与弹窗确认保护。 [插件与插件市场](docs/guide/plugins.md) · [开发规范](docs/plugins.md) - **三个平台，同一个轻量化环境。** macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上的 Cage 都运行同一个轻量化 Debian 13 环境，无需维护复杂的多系统客机，工具与操作方式一致。 [Debian 环境](docs/guide/guest-systems.md) - **控制共享范围。** 只共享默认工作区和明确打开的项目文件夹；主机的 Claude 登录、浏览器配置和 SSH 密钥不会自动导入。 - **看清网络状态。** 内置代理管理支持导入订阅、选择节点和检查出口。关键检查未通过时，环境保持离线；代理不可用时没有直连回退。 - **下次继续使用。** 工具、文件和登录状态保存在虚拟磁盘里，关闭窗口可以保留后台任务。 - **管理多个 Claude Code 订阅。** 查看额度、为新会话分配账号，并在明确授权后切换账号接续历史。 [Claude Code](docs/guide/accounts.md) - **从手机继续处理任务。** Android / iPhone 配对电脑，接续 Claude Code 对话与工具审批，或操作远程浏览器和 Claude Desktop。 [手机连接](docs/guide/mobile.md) - **把环境放到自己的服务器。** 通过 SSH 部署或连接 Linux VPS，工具、任务和数据留在服务器，无需 KVM。 [云端部署与 SSH](docs/guide/cloud.md) - **通过私网连接设备。** 在 Cage 内登录 Tailscale，查看网络中的设备，使用 SSH、Web 与其他 TCP 服务。 [Tailscale 私网](docs/guide/tailscale.md) 浏览器收藏、无痕会话、Cookie、扩展、密码保险箱，以及外观、资源、存储和工具更新，见[完整使用文档](https://claude-cage.com/docs/)。 ## 快速开始 把这句话发给你的 agent（codex，dsh，workbuddy，反正不会是 claude code😁） ```markdown 帮我拉取 https://

content.readme:
Pinky

Let AI use your iPhone or Android phone, with you in the loop: any agent from macOS, Windows or Linux, or Pinky itself, right on the phone.

Download · Get started · FAQ · Discord

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Türkçe


A real Claude Code run on an Android 16 emulator. Pinky asks before payments by default; this run also asks before messages.

Pinky lets any agent (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor or a script) operate a real iPhone or Android phone over MCP, while you watch on your computer, approve risky steps, take over and review what happened. Pinky can also do tasks by itself, with an AI model you choose: from your computer, or in Pinky's app right on the phone, with no computer at all. Whoever does the task, approvals are enforced by Pinky's gateway, not by instructions to the agent. - **Every platform.** One app for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel), Windows and Linux. It drives Android phones (Android 10 to 17) and iPhones on iOS 17.4 or later: nothing to install on iOS 27 and later, and Pinky on the iPhone, Pinky's app, installed once from a Mac with Xcode on iOS 17.4 to 26, which you can also choose on iOS 27 (tried there, on a phone below it and on Simulators; [details](#phones)). - **Tiny and native.** The window is drawn by [MyGo](https://github.com/egoist/mygo) on the GPU, with no Electron and no webview: a 16–22 MB download that idles at about 70 MB of memory and 0% CPU on a Mac. - **Any agent, one click.** Settings › Agents connects Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor and more, and any agent that can use MCP servers works, on the same computer or over HTTP. - **Pinky on the phone, no computer needed.** Pinky's app on Android and iPhone does tasks by itself with a model you choose, from DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi and GLM to Claude, GPT, Gemini and local models in Ollama or LM Studio. Type or speak a task, or share something to it; on Android, ask about what the screen shows from a floating button or the power button, and let it work on a hidden background screen while you keep using the phone ([how](#pinky-on-the-phone)). - **Scheduled tasks and memory.** Pinky can run a task at set times or tell you when a condition holds, on the computer and on Android. After a task it may suggest a note to remember, such as a preference you told it, and keeps it only if you say yes ([more](#ask-pinky)). - **Locked phone? Unlock it from your computer.** Save the phone's PIN in Pinky once, then confirm each unlock with Touch ID, Windows Hello or your keyring's password. Agents never see the PIN. - **Free and open source** under the Apache-2.0 license, with no account to create.

You approve the risky steps. Payments, trades and transfers wait for your click; in Settings › Safety you can have sends, orders, deletions, calls, installs, links that leave the app and settings changes wait too, or every step. Pinky spots these buttons in 10 languages. The rules run in Pinky's gateway, so an agent can't approve itself, even when text on the screen tries to talk it into it.
Off-limits by default. Banking, wallet and password-manager apps are invisible to agents, and agents can't type into password or one-time-code fields. When an agent needs a banking or wallet app for a task, it asks, and you can allow that app for that task only. Every new agent needs your approval and gets only the scope you give it.

Your phone stays yours. On Android 13 and later, agents work on a hidden second screen, so the phone's own screen stays yours, or off and locked. On older Android phones and on iPhones they use the main screen.

# MyGo Music

A native desktop music player written in Go with [MyGo](https://github.com/egoist/mygo), no WebView. It plays your local files out of the box, and everything else comes from plugins.

## Features

- Local files (MP3, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, WAV, and ALAC, FLAC or AAC in .m4a and .aac) with tags, covers and `.lrc` lyrics
- Playlists, liked songs, search, albums and artists
- Now Playing with lyric stage styles, cover wall, queue, shuffle and repeat
- Notch player on macOS, tray, media keys
- Audio cache, fades on pause and seek, loudness normalization
- Session restore
- Podcast captions, written down on the device as episodes play
- English and Simplified Chinese
- Plugins can add accounts, catalogs, podcasts, stations, comments and pages of their own

# UnfairPlay

UnfairPlay recovers a FairPlay model from an enrolled Mac and uses it to
decrypt personalized iOS IPAs. It is a standalone Go program.

It does not log in to Apple, buy apps, or download IPAs. You can use ipatool or
another downloader for that part.

## Legal and ethical use

Use UnfairPlay only with apps you lawfully acquired and accounts and devices
you control. It is intended for interoperability, preservation, and authorized
research. The authors do not condone piracy, credential theft, copyright
infringement, or unauthorized distribution of decrypted apps.

## Discord

Project discussion and support: [UnfairPlay Discord](https://discord.gg/hpwvuQHfaf).

## Build

```sh
go build -o unfairplay ./cmd/unfairplay
```

## Usage

First, sign in to the native Mac App Store. Install an iPhone or iPad app and
open it once. Set up reusable decryption from that installed app:

```sh
sudo ./unfairplay setup --app /Applications/App.app
```

No separate IPA download is needed when the installed bundle contains supported
encrypted images and their matching licenses. Setup and collect build a private
validation archive from the complete inner iOS bundle, preserving its bytes.
Unsupported, incomplete, symlinked, or already-decrypted bundles fail closed.

To validate against a downloaded IPA instead, pass `--ipa` explicitly:

```sh
sudo ./unfairplay setup --app /Applications/App.app --ipa App.ipa
```

The installed app and IPA must be the same app and belong to the same Store
enrollment. An explicit IPA takes precedence; failed validation never triggers
an automatic retry using the installed bundle.

Recovery still authenticates the selected SINF and requires complete archive
decryption before saving a model. Reports identify `validation_source` as
`installed-app` or `provided`. A reconstructed validation archive describes the
installed variant, not the original Store download or any omitted architectures.

Large enrollment databases print bounded recovery progress to standard error.
The final JSON result remains on standard output.

The setup result includes `plaintext_verified` for the validation archive.
A successful setup can report `false` when any decrypted image lacks
pre-encryption hashes; this is separate from whether the model was recovered
and saved successfully.

The saved model is private. It is tied to the Mac App Store enrollment, not to
one app, so it can decrypt other personalized IPAs from the same enrollment.
Back it up only in encrypted storage and never share it.

Decrypt another IPA:

```sh
./unfairplay decrypt --input AnotherApp.ipa
```

The default model directory is inside the user configuration directory. Set
`UNFAIRPLAY_MODEL_DIR` or pass `--model` to use another location.

### Export enrollment now, choose an IPA later

On an already enrolled Mac, export the enrollment without supplying an installed
app or IPA:

```sh
sudo ./unfairplay export-enrollment --output enrollment.snapshot
```

The output parent directory must already exist. The command never overwrites an
existing snapshot. It writes a mode-0600 file and restores its ownership to the
invoking user when run through sudo.

The snapshot contains the hardware identity and one distinct supported SIDB
container. Export authenticates and decodes the container, but does not select
an account/key route or produce a validated model. It neither enrolls the Mac
nor adds missing licenses. Treat it as broader private enrollment state: keep it
secret and transfer it only to machines you control, preserving mode 0600.

Later, on macOS or Linux, select a personalized IPA and run setup as your normal
user:

```sh
./unfairplay setup --enrollment enrollment.snapshot --ipa App.ipa
./unfairplay decrypt --input AnotherApp.ipa
```

This uses the IPA's own licenses; no installed-app path is required. Setup
authenticates the exact selected route and signed page-key envelopes, then
decrypts and validates the complete IPA before installing the usual reusable
model. Missing pre-encryption hashes remain `plaintext_verified=false`.
Snapshot setup currently requires every encrypted image in the IPA to share
one user/key selector; multiple-selector IPAs reject explicitly. A snapshot can
be reused with different IPAs or selectors already present in its captured
state. Missing records require an appropriate enrollment; recovery never tries
other routes. Re-export after enrollment changes when necessary.

`--app` and `--enrollment` are mutually exclusive. Existing app-based setup and
saved models continue to work. Synthetic tests cover this workflow; private
installed-app versus snapshot equivalence is an opt-in control in [QA.md](QA.md).

### Recoverable IPA decryption

```sh
./unfairplay decrypt-recoverable --input App.ipa --model source-model.bin
./unfairplay encrypt --input App.decrypted-recoverable.ipa --model destination-model.bin
```

Finallyshell

An SSH client with FinalShell's layout and vertical session tabs, written in Go.



English · 简体中文
Install · Features · Shortcuts · Full documentation

If you have used FinalShell, you already know your way around: server stats at the top left, sessions under them, the terminal on the right and the remote files below it. Finallyshell keeps that layout and puts the session tabs in a vertical list you can scroll and drag to reorder. It is a native app written in Go with the [MyGo](https://github.com/egoist/mygo) UI toolkit, so there's no Java runtime to install. The terminal is libghostty-vt, the terminal engine of [Ghostty](https://ghostty.org). Passwords go to the system's keychain, never to a file. > [!IMPORTANT] > The project's only official places are this repository and its site, [tooonychen.github.io/finallyshell](https://tooonychen.github.io/finallyshell/), and [Releases](https://github.com/TooonyChen/finallyshell/releases) here is the only official download. Any other site that offers downloads under the Finallyshell name is not affiliated with this project. ## Install Download the latest build from [Releases](https://github.com/TooonyChen/finallyshell/releases/latest): | System | File | |---|---| | macOS (Apple silicon) | `finallyshell--arm64.dmg` | | macOS (Intel) | `finallyshell--amd64.dmg` | | Windows (x64) | `finallyshell-setup--amd64.exe`, or the portable `.zip` | | Debian, Ubuntu (x64) | `finallyshell__amd64.deb` | | Other Linux (x64) | `finallyshell--linux-amd64.tar.gz`; `sh install.sh` installs it in `~/.local` | | Debian, Ubuntu (ARM64) | `finallyshell__arm64.deb` | | Other Linux (ARM64) | `finallyshell--linux-arm64.tar.gz`; `sh install.sh` installs it in `~/.local` | To try what's on main before it's released, every merge also publishes a preview build on the [Releases](https://github.com/TooonyChen/finallyshell/releases) page, marked Pre-release. Windows SmartScreen may warn about the unsigned installer: click "More info", then "Run anyway". On Linux, the tray icon needs `libayatana-appindicator3`, and remembering passwords needs a Secret Service keyring (GNOME Keyring, KWallet, KeePassXC). 每个空间对应一个本地文件夹，拥有独立的名称、图标、置顶常驻文档与阅读现场。在侧边栏双指轻扫或按 ⌃1…⌃9 即可滑入下一个空间；顶部的全局收藏跨越所有空间，点一下就在当前空间原地打开。打开「••• › 编辑主题颜色…」，可自由组合 1–3 色渐变、调节通透光影与颗粒感，或在浅色白纸与飞书风格深色纸面（`#1F2023`，自动重映射全部文字与高亮色调）之间平滑切换。 ### 资料库：所有空间，一眼尽览

点击左下角的资料库图标或按 ⇧⌘L，侧边栏会平滑展开成一排空间卡片，每张卡片都以各自空间的主题色绘制，文件夹与文档随手可点开跳转。插件管理与保留 30 天的「最近删除」也集中在这里。 ### 专注时让开，需要时浮现
